title: Ledger record: claim
description: A proposition whose authority and provenance are explicit (PRD §10.2). A claim produced by an agent is `proposed` until an authorized review confirms it; an agent saying "done" is a completion claim, not verified evidence (PRD §10.5).

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose. Named properties are optional and documentary; a later task pins the payload contract per record type.
